The end of one monitoring period must immediately precede the start of the next monitoring period for the next reporting year. All production days must be monitored and all venting accounted for. ( i ) You must use any of the applicable methods described in paragraphs (i)(1) through (4) of this section to conduct a performance test to determine the concentration of CH4 in the exhaust gas. This concentration must be used to develop a CH4 emission factor (kg/MMBtu) for estimating combustion slip from reciprocating internal combustion engines or gas turbines as specified in § 98.233(z)(4) . You may not conduct performance tests during period of startup, shutdown or malfunction. You must conduct three separate test runs for each performance test. Each test run must be conducted within 10 percent of 100 percent peak (or the highest achievable) load and last at least 1 hour. ( 1 ) EPA Method 18 in appendix A-6 to part 60 of this chapter .
